types.name: Simple price relatives and aggregative index
types.description: Asks for a price relative, a simple aggregative index or a simple average of relatives, or a basic fact such as the base-year index being 100.

types.name: Laspeyres, Paasche, Fisher and others
types.description: Gives prices and quantities for two years and asks for a weighted index by a named formula.

types.name: Tests of adequacy
types.description: Asks which test a formula satisfies (unit, time reversal, factor reversal, circular) or what a test states.

types.name: Link relatives and chain index
types.description: Gives prices over several years or link relatives and asks for link relatives, chain-base indices or conversion to a fixed base.

types.name: Base shifting and splicing
types.description: Gives an index series and asks to recalculate it on a new base year, or to join (splice) an old and a new series.

types.name: Cost of living index and real wages
types.description: Gives group weights and indices (or expenditures), or a money wage and a price index, and asks for the cost of living index, real wage, purchasing power or required DA.
